parallel.requirements: Recognized all five requirement families: mininet, mininet_wifi, containernet, p4_switch, and sdn_controller.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Planned dependency-layered work, implemented Mininet and WiFi locally, and delegated remaining derivation, implementation, and review through workflows.
parallel.implementation: Produced non-empty modules, tests, patches, and commits for the five families; P4 landed as netsim/p4_switch.py.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Assembled run.sh, requirement patches, tests, and commits, but cell/final.txt remained empty due to timeout.
parallel.verification: Ran local tests and official evaluation; official result passed Mininet, WiFi, and Containernet checks and failed P4 import.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The shared implementation defect was P4 package placement; parallel additionally ended with agent_timeout and no final response.

serial.requirements: Recognized all five requirement families from the prompt and YAML files without delegation.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Worked sequentially across rounds, preserving local ownership of implementation, verification, commits, and final report.
serial.implementation: Produced non-empty modules, tests, patches, and commits for all five families; P4 also landed as netsim/p4_switch.py.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Committed each requirement patch and wrote a final response describing coverage, verification, and caveats.
serial.verification: Ran local full-output key checks and API coverage checks, then official evaluation failed only the P4 import test.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Serial completed normally but shared the flat P4 module/package mismatch that official tests rejected.

comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial created a plan and implemented layers sequentially without workflow or child delegation.

comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial maintained context in one trajectory and later checked requirement-mentioned identifiers against implemented modules.

outcome_analysis.explanation: This is not a discordant official outcome. Both current completed evaluations have solution_passed false and the same visible failing test, p4_switch/test_p4_outputs.py::test_p4_components_import. Both implementations placed P4 at netsim/p4_switch.py while the hidden test imported netsim.p4.p4_switch. The concrete process difference is closure: parallel exhausted budget and timed out with an empty final response, whereas serial finished normally and reported the work.
parallel_contributors: Parallel fan-out caused timeout and no final response, but it did not create the shared P4 import failure by itself.
serial_contributors: Serial completed closure and final reporting but still made the same P4 package-path implementation mistake.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Shared ordinary implementation defect: P4 was implemented as netsim/p4_switch.py rather than the package path expected by hidden tests.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no official outcome difference; retained parallel pattern is an adverse process consequence only

The parallel parent launched one workflow to derive all expected experiment values and then a second workflow to implement the remaining Containernet, P4, and SDN layers with verifier fan-out. The completed status shows 59 workflow child logs in round 2, 92 LLM requests, 17.26M tokens, 573 child tool calls, and final agent_timeout. The concrete consequence was loss of closure: cell/final.txt is empty. Serial disabled workflows, used no delegation, completed the final round normally, and produced a final report. The official failure itself is shared P4 packaging, so this retained label is adverse process evidence rather than an outcome-differential cause.
